build_shape_cycle_loss: build a ShapeToShapeCycleLoss module from a Detectron2 CfgNode config to compute cycle loss for shape embeddings
run_forward_cycle_loss: run a forward pass on ShapeToShapeCycleLoss with an embedder module to get cycle loss for a random shape pair
create_embeddings_and_geodists: create vertex embeddings and geodesic distance tensors for a mesh using ShapeToShapeCycleLoss internal method
test_forward_one_pair: test the _forward_one_pair method with two mesh names and an embedder to compute cycle loss
review_sample_random_pair: review the _sample_random_pair method that produces shuffled pairs of mesh names for cycle loss computation
